description: Create a new website monitor that keeps checking after this conversation ends: monity.ai checks the page on a schedule in its own cloud with a stealth browser (Camoufox, an anti-detection Firefox) and smart proxies that switch to residential routes when a site blocks the check, keeps a full-page screenshot and a full HTML copy of the page for every check, and alerts only when the change matters (requires a write-scope API key; subject to the plan's monitor limit). compareType AUTO (default) covers most pages; VISUAL for pixel comparison, TEXT for keyword monitoring, HTML for markup diffs. Express the full intent in one call: use notifyWhen for a natural-language alert condition ('price drops below $500'), or notifyConditions + outputExtractor/jsonPath for deterministic threshold alerts without AI.

actions.description: Ordered list of interactions to perform before each check, e.g. [{"type":"CLICK","selector":"#accept-cookies"},{"type":"WAIT","value":1500},{"type":"CLICK","selector":".load-more"}]. Use this when the content to monitor is behind a cookie banner, a tab, a "show more" control, or a dropdown. Max 20 steps. Script and JS/CSS injection steps are dashboard-only and rejected here.

active.description: Defaults to true; false keeps the step but skips it

selector.description: How to find the element, as a Playwright selector. CSS by default ("#accept-cookies", ".product .price"); a string starting with "/" is treated as XPath ("//button[contains(text(),'Show more')]"); Playwright engine prefixes also work, and "text=Show more" is usually the most robust choice for a button identified by its label rather than by a hashed class. Required for CLICK, TYPE, SELECT, MOUSEOVER and BLOCK.

type.description: CLICK an element, TYPE text into it, SELECT a dropdown option, MOUSEOVER to reveal a menu, SCROLL (optionally by pixels), WAIT a number of milliseconds, REFRESH the page, or BLOCK (remove) an element from the page before comparing

value.description: Text to type for TYPE, option to pick for SELECT, milliseconds for WAIT (max 60000), pixels for SCROLL

frequency.description: Minutes between checks, as a string: '5', '15', '30', '60' (hourly), '180', '360', '720', '1440' (daily), '10080' (weekly), '302400' (monthly). Omit for the plan default. A frequency faster than the plan allows is raised to the plan minimum.

jsonPath.description: For JSON API endpoints: JSONPath to the value to monitor, e.g. $.data.items[0].price. Starts with '$'.

keywords.description: TEXT monitors only: comma-separated keywords to look for, e.g. "sold out, unavailable"

keywordsAction.description: TEXT monitors only: alert when keywords are ADDED to the page (default) or REMOVED from it

labels.description: Label names to file the monitor under (up to 10); existing labels with the same name are reused.

name.description: Monitor name (defaults to the URL host/path)

notifyConditions.description: Deterministic alert conditions on the extracted output (no AI credits). All conditions must pass. Requires the output to change. Mutually exclusive with notifyWhen. Not available for HTML monitors.

conditionType.description: con = output contains value, eq = equals, not = does not equal, gt/gte/lt/lte = numeric comparison of the extracted output

notifyEmails.description: Extra email addresses to CC on alerts (workspace members are emailed by default)

notifyWebhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to POST alerts to (HMAC-signed with the account webhook secret)

notifyWhen.description: Natural-language alert condition evaluated by AI on every check, e.g. 'notify me when the price drops below $500' or 'alert when the Pro plan changes'. Mutually exclusive with notifyConditions.

outputExtractor.description: How to extract the monitored value from the page text: NUMBER pulls the first number (good for prices), REGEX applies outputExtractorPattern, NONE keeps the full text.

outputExtractorPattern.description: Regular expression for outputExtractor: REGEX — bare pattern or /pattern/flags; the first capture group (or full match) becomes the monitored output, e.g. 'In stock: (\d+)'

selector.description: CSS selector of ONE element to monitor instead of the whole page (e.g. '.product-price' or '#stock-status'). Makes an element monitor that is found by this selector on every check; leave compareType unset.

skillAlerts.description: Alert rules per skill, only when the user names a threshold or a rule, e.g. {"perf": {"lcp": 3}}: a number sets the rule's threshold and turns it on (seconds for timings, MB for page weight, days for expiry, 0-100 for scores), true/false turns a rule on or off, null resets it. Rule ids are in list_skills. A skill named here is added to the monitor.

skills.description: Extra checks to run on the page at every check, each alerting on its own rules, on top of change monitoring: skill names from list_skills ('perf', 'seo', 'a11y', 'links', 'xss', 'tls', 'scripts', 'privacy', …) or plain words ('core web vitals', 'ssl', 'gdpr'). Add one only when the user asks for what it does. A skill the plan does not include is not added and comes back in skillsSkipped.

websiteUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to monitor

workspaceId.description: Workspace to create the monitor in (from list_workspaces). Defaults to the key owner's personal workspace, which on a business account is NOT visible to the rest of the team — pass this to put it somewhere shared.

name: create_monitor
title: Create monitor
